content_of_post_to_comment: It is possible to be so humble that you accept your sufferings, and that can lead to accepting the sufferings of humanity, blunting charity. This isn't even that rare of a condition, indeed most people embody it at some point.
comment: There’s an interesting tension between humility and compassion: accepting one’s own suffering can cultivate empathy, but it can also normalize pain so deeply that injustice starts to look inevitable. The challenge may be keeping acceptance of reality separate from acceptance of preventable harm.
